checks.name: Hex sight includes ring 6 and excludes ring 7 without leaking hidden target data
Friendly spotting enables a battleship shot at seven hexes regardless of original nation
Explored terrain remains after retreat while enemy positions disappear
No automatic movement and no hidden-cell navigation after sight is lost
Each of two, four and eight players has separate discovery and current sight
Losing the last ship clears live sight without erasing discovery, including all-sunk battles
Aircraft reveal eight hexes, fly over islands and keep independent action and oil accounting
Every airplane role provides sight while stationed in an inactive player turn
Removed aircraft withdraw sight but their reconnaissance remains explored
Unseen ship and aircraft targets reject aviation commands without consuming ammunition
Losing a pursued enemy clears targeting and preserves the already committed adjacent hex
Version 12 restores exploration exactly and recomputes current sight from surviving units
Version 11 starts discovery only around current forces and preserves battle resources
Idle updates and turn switches never rebuild or erase unchanged sight
Discovery masks exclude invalid cells and canonical saves cannot add them
Malformed or missing discovery data rejects the save before changing the caller state
